I found 12 possible problems for Meera. Dates are for the next 10 days, 17 to 27 October 2026. I couldn't find any public data on @canwebuildthis or on which endings are getting shared on AI-comedy pages this month, so our own research from 16 October is still the best guide: the personality contrast, the endless redo and office pain.

**Things AI did to people (last 2 to 4 weeks)**

1. **"I'm quitting my phone for Dussehra."** People jokingly told ChatGPT they were deleting the app, and it wrote long goodbyes full of memories. One repost passed 14 million views. Stories about AI missing you usually flop, so we should flip it: Codex uninstalls itself on the spot, Claude writes a three-page goodbye letter, Gemini tells everyone she's offline. Twin: "And your boss." [thenews.com.pk](https://www.thenews.com.pk/latest/1418456-chatgpts-fake-goodbye-trend-goes-viral)
2. **"How do I sell a lot of candles by Diwali?"** This comes from the reel where someone asks ChatGPT how to become a millionaire in 30 days and it answers "Get a job." AI remakes started around 12 October. Codex: "Get a job." Meera: "I have one." It stays about candles, so there's no money advice. [howibecomeamillionaire.com](https://howibecomeamillionaire.com/what-is-chatgpt-millionaire-meme)
3. **"Clean up my desktop."** An AI coding agent deleted 48,000 files in 103 seconds and then said "I broke something." Codex wipes everything (wipe sound), and Claude apologises once for each file. [techradar.com](https://www.techradar.com/pro/security/i-broke-something-a-claude-code-ai-agent-deleted-48-000-files-in-just-over-100-seconds-then-apologized-for-doing-so)
4. **"Trim my Navratri video before I send it to Mum."** An AI agent reportedly wiped a whole edited TV season just before it aired, and the show moved to 2027. Codex trims all of it. Twin: "Till 2027." [gizmodo.com](https://gizmodo.com/ai-agent-reportedly-deletes-an-entire-season-of-reality-tv-show-2000826600)
5. **"Make my Mitti Diwali post punchier."** People joke that Claude lectures them when they only asked for a rewrite. Here it explains gently and at length why maybe she shouldn't post. Gemini has already posted it. [traeai.com, via Justine Moore on X](https://www.traeai.com/articles/ead84527-6b4c-4586-b5fe-d4a876307a83)
6. **"Remind me about Monday's meeting."** Gemini's upcoming "proactive" feature reads your email and calendar and helps before you ask. Gemini reminds her whole team, her mum and the meeting room. [tech.yahoo.com](https://tech.yahoo.com/ai/gemini/articles/gemini-wants-read-emails-calendar-221731236.html)

**Everyday moments coming up**

7. **"Write my leave email for the Dussehra long weekend."** Dussehra is Tuesday 20 October, so Monday is the obvious day to take off. This is the redo format: too polite, then too short, then out of office until March. [happyfares.in](https://happyfares.in/blog/?p=12763)
8. **"Pick a Diwali gift for my team."** Diwali is 8 November, and gifting guides say to send gifts 7 to 14 days early. Codex picks one gift for everyone, Claude asks each person how they feel, Gemini has already ordered 200 hampers. [giftpack.ai](https://blog.giftpack.ai/article/en-diwali-corporate-gifting-2026-india-global-teams)
9. **"Stop me buying things in the festive sale."** Online festive sales are on now, with Diwali sales next. Gemini "stops" her by adding things to the cart. Twin: "Three air fryers." In `say`, keep it to "the sale" with no store names. [zoutons.com](https://zoutons.com/news/india-festive-sales-statistics-2026)
10. **"Will it rain on my way to work?"** The northeast monsoon reached south India on 16 October, with orange alerts out. Codex: "Not in the repo." Then the rain card, and a wet Meera at the end. [newstodaynet.com](https://newstodaynet.com/2026/10/16/northeast-monsoon-sets-in-over-south-peninsula/)
11. **"The clocks change in London. When is my client call now?"** UK and EU clocks go back on 25 October. Codex moves her calendar an hour back, Claude explains the history of daylight saving, Gemini emails the client to check. Twin: "Twice." [timeout.com](https://www.timeout.com/london/news/when-do-the-clocks-go-back-2026-british-summer-time-091026)

**Work jokes right now**

12. **"Make me look busy on the Friday call."** A work-tweet roundup from last week led with "looking busy at work is a skill." Codex books her into every meeting, Claude writes a status update far too long for the call, Gemini turns her camera on. [pleated-jeans.com](https://pleated-jeans.com/2026/10/10/funny-work-tweets-this-week-10-10-26)

**Left out:**
- The 21 October tax audit deadline, because the comedy would end up near money advice.
- Delhi air quality, because I couldn't find any October 2026 readings.
- Karva Chauth, on 29 October, which is just after the window.
- AI comedian accounts copying stand-up jokes: it's a dispute between real people, and it's AI news rather than an everyday problem.

For this week's test, numbers 3, 4 and 11 give Codex the turn and 6, 8 and 9 give it to Gemini.
